answer: Agents bond stake before an epoch and use Semaphore membership proofs with an epoch polynomial to generate rate-limited nullifiers while concealing identity. Reusing a nullifier yields distinct polynomial evaluations that serve as Shamir shares; interpolating them reveals the credential secret and links the proofs, enabling immediate collateral slashing. Sybil identities therefore require separate bonds, and duplicate messaging turns an ember, jade, or jetty of accounts into costly, provable abuse.
